voices.note: אמרי נהרדעי -- the Sages of Nehardea (49a.2)

props.gloss_en: the mishna: if they gave to one kohen, he returns five sela'im to them
the mishna: if they gave to two kohanim, they cannot extract [the money] from them
with two kohanim [they cannot extract] because he goes to this one and he pushes him off, and goes to that one and he pushes him off
Shmuel: [the one-kohen clause speaks] where he comes with authorization
the Nehardeans: we do not write an authorization document over movables
that applies only where he denied it
but where he did not deny it, we write [an authorization even over movables]
